partnership_announcements.description: Red Sea Global renewed its sponsorship partnership with Al-Ahli Saudi Football Club for the 2026–2027 season. The agreement moves AMAALA branding onto the first-team shirts and extends the relationship that began in 2023.

press_references.value: The key takeaways from FII Rome

partnership_announcements.description: Red Sea Global signed an agreement with Sequest to pilot durable carbon-removal technology within its Red Sea destination, one of three disclosed deals at FII Priority Europe in Rome.

press_references.value: First guests arrive at Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island from 20 May

partnership_announcements.description: Red Sea Global and Kingdom Holding Company have formalized a 50-50 joint venture partnership to develop the SAR 2.6 billion Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island, combining institutional and private capital to scale Saudi Arabia’s luxury tourism.

press_references.value: Forbes Travel Guide Grants The Red Sea Destination the World’s First Comprehensive Destination Accreditation

partnership_announcements.description: Red Sea Global worked with Forbes Travel Guide in a strategic collaboration to create and implement 182 service standards, culminating in The Red Sea becoming the first destination to earn Forbes Travel Guide’s comprehensive destination-level accreditation.

press_references.value: Saudi real estate developer Red Sea Global launches AI venture fund

partnership_announcements.description: Red Sea Global formed a new AI-focused investment fund in partnership with venture capital firm Bunat Ventures to back 25 early- and growth-stage AI startups in Saudi Arabia over three years.

press_references.value: Saudi: Red Sea Global, stc launch $319mln digital partnership in tourism sector

partnership_announcements.description: Red Sea Global announced a strategic partnership with stc Group, under which stc will invest over SAR 1.2 billion ($319 million) to deploy next‑generation connectivity and ICT across RSG’s destinations, including AI-driven services, cloud operations, digital twins, analytics, cybersecurity, and data centers.

press_references.value: Saudi: RSG announces opening of Six Senses luxury beachfront resort

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global and Six Senses Hotels Resorts Spas have launched the new Six Senses Amaala luxury beachfront resort at the Amaala destination in Saudi Arabia, welcoming first guests from mid-July 2026.

press_references.value: First guests arrive at Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island from 20 May

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global and Kingdom Holding Company have launched the Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island, the first joint-venture-developed resort in RSG’s portfolio, welcoming its first guests from 20 May as part of The Red Sea destination.

press_references.value: Red Sea Global Reveals ADRENA, a New Adventure and Entertainment District

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global, via its Red Sea Sports & Entertainment subsidiary, is launching ADRENA, a new adventure and entertainment district near Shura Island at The Red Sea destination, opening to invited guests from 15 February and the public from 1 March 2026.

press_references.value: Red Sea Global announces the opening of AMAALA: The world’s new coastal lifestyle destination

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global announced AMAALA Triple Bay, an ultra-luxury wellness coastal destination on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea, with six initial resorts, a yacht club, a marine life institute, a marina, and a Wellness Route opening in the coming months.

press_references.value: First resorts on Shura Island to welcome guests in coming weeks

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global said Shura Links, Saudi Arabia’s first island golf course on Shura Island at The Red Sea destination, will open in September as part of the phase-one rollout.

press_references.value: Saudi Arabia's Red Sea Global unveils Shura Island luxury tourism destination

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global announced a soft opening in the coming weeks for phase one of Shura Island, a luxury tourism destination on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea, featuring SLS, EDITION and InterContinental hotels and the Shura Links golf course, with eight more resorts to follow.

press_references.value: Laheq Island unveiled as the first luxury residential destination at The Red Sea

product_launches.description: Red Sea Global has launched Laheq Island, a luxury residential destination at The Red Sea, featuring private residences, hotels, and amenities, all powered by renewable energy.

press_references.value: Red Sea Global introduces Red Sea Residences

product_launches.description: A collection of exclusive homes offering luxury living along the Red Sea coast, designed by renowned architects and interior designers.

press_references.value: Red Sea Global and Zain KSA Launch Region’s First Unified Critical Communication System

product_launches.description: The Unified Critical Communication System integrates PTT, DMR, and air-to-ground communication to support sustainable tourism development.
